row.notes: Rebuilds the R&D resource-points (RP) summary view-model. Reads career root at vm+0x7828, season/event/session overrides at +0x7818/+0x781c/+0x7820 (-1 = current), gets the ResourcePoints component (k_Career_ResourcePointsComponentDesc), builds two RP source lists (player team and the entrant at +0x7840) via Vm_Unk_141802fa0, sums 0x30-byte source rows as round((count*perUnit+bonus)*scale) clamped to [min,max], multiplies by Career_ResourcePoints_GetGainMultiplier and emits rows through FUN_141806390 (source ids from byte table 0x14571d25d..0x14571d26c, id 0xc excluded from totals). If +0x7810 != 0 it also writes projected RP ints to nodes +0x50/+0x70, total strings +0x110/+0x130, wallet (Career_Get_RpWallet, 1000000 when unlimited) to +0x170 and wallet minus spend to +0x150/+0x190, and lists enabled upgrades per department (bool node +0x1d0). Sets +0x7838=1 when valid. UI only: good read hook for RP gain maths, not the place to change RP.
